purpose: Test training-only relative-motion supervision for the recurrent memory used during return navigation
motivation: Among nine brick approaches, four never return to docking range and three reach the box with an incorrect heading
preActionTargets: initial-body-relative forward displacement divided by eight metres
initial-body-relative lateral displacement divided by eight metres
onlyDifference: eventPose adds a training-only 128-to-4 GRU readout and mean squared error of weight1 on valid frames
matching: All original core and camera-event parameters byte-identical at initialization; identical fit episode order and data in both arms
evaluation: Canonical eight-case screen for matched snapshots, paired full32 if either arm returns in both room types; original qualification and reserved final gates unchanged
